Subject: Apology for My Oversight  

Hi [Colleague’s Name],

I’m sorry for [briefly describe what happened—e.g., missing the deadline on the report]. I understand it caused inconvenience and extra work for you, and I take full responsibility. Moving forward, I’ll [state corrective action—e.g., set reminders and double‑check timelines] to ensure this doesn’t happen again.

Please let me know if there’s anything else I can do to make things right.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]
